adamw_schedule: 5% linear warmup, cosine decay to 1% initial LR over allotted updates
accounting: fixed declared arithmetic cost per training update; excludes augmentation/preprocessing, validation, checkpoint I/O and precision-management overhead
precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast, FP32 parameters/optimizer; CPU smoke tests FP32
checkpoint_selection: maximum validation macro hard Dice over classes 1 and 2 at fixed compute milestones
name: unet48_budget_candidate04
pilot_scope: Dice-only width-48 residual U-Net, fold 0 seed 0; no constraints
calibration_policy: No calibration for Dice-only budget selection.
budget_accounting: Dice prefix, all calibration attempts, and all subsequent training attempts charged within the exact reference budget.
training_loss: Dice + ramp * (connected_zero + band_weight*bands + edge_weight*original_edge + sdf_weight*SDF); absent terms omitted
sources: Canonical two-step balanced BCE bands and original pooled edge consistency; full-volume classwise clipped signed-distance boundary loss.

signed_distance.recommended: full-volume classwise signed-distance boundary loss using existing softmax logits
signed_distance.formula: mean over classes and voxels of (p_c - y_c) * clip(phi_c, -8, 8) / 8
signed_distance.sign: negative inside each class, positive outside; half-voxel convention as in existing spline SDF helper
signed_distance.geometry: compute ground-truth distance maps after spatial augmentation, not by warping a cached distance map
signed_distance.existing_code: semantic_constraints/spline_refinement/train.py:signed_distance; old refinement loss is prediction-band-gated and needs a separate refiner
signed_distance.modification_notice: Clipping, class selection and the constant subtraction are explicit experiment choices; subtracting y*phi changes values but not parameter gradients.
signed_distance.loss: Full-volume mean (p_c-y_c)*phi_c over classes 1 and 2; no band mask
signed_distance.computation: Recompute from transformed training labels before the training forward; cache neither augmented geometry nor validation labels.

budget_selection: Select only full-schedule final validation macro foreground Dice in [0.70,0.75]; fresh seeded run per candidate.
